:::{#def-measurable-rectangle}
#### Measurable rectangle

Let $(S, \salg)$ and $(T, \salgT)$ be [measurable spaces](#def-measurable-space).
A **measurable rectangle** is a [Cartesian product](sets.qmd#def-cartesian-product)
$A \times B$ with $A \in \salg$ and $B \in \salgT$.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#def-product-sigma-algebra}
#### Product $\sigma$-algebra

For the measurable spaces $(S, \salg)$ and $(T, \salgT)$ of @def-measurable-rectangle,
the **product $\sigma$-algebra** $\salg \otimes \salgT$
is the $\sigma$-algebra on $S \times T$
[generated by](#def-generated-sigma-algebra) the measurable rectangles.

:::
